title: The Geometry of Lies: Knowledge and Persona Directions for Detecting Deception in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.26545v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Linear probes are the cheapest LLM lie detectors but often fail to transfer across kinds of lie. Label-free directions from honest and deceptive role-play are untested at 70B scale and on lies about knowledge, where a lie and an honest denial can be identical. We widen a published persona bank with roles that deny knowledge they have, plus honest counterparts. At each model's middle layer the resulting persona direction ranks lies across Liars' Bench better than single-dataset probes on three of its four models; it fails on Qwen, even when Qwen stays in role far more often. On Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct it beats directions from a random persona bank, but its gain over the published direction is within the range of random widenings. On lies about knowledge, persona directions mainly track a reply's wording: where lies and honest denials share their words, our three main contrasts stay inside the random-direction band on Llama and Qwen and rea

translated_title: 谎言的几何学：用于检测大语言模型欺骗行为的知识与人格方向
translated_abstract: 线性探针是最廉价的大语言模型谎言检测器，但往往难以在不同类型的谎言之间迁移。基于诚实与欺骗性角色扮演的无标签方向在70B规模上、以及在关于知识的谎言（谎言与诚实的否认可能完全相同）场景中尚未得到检验。我们通过加入否认自身已有知识的角色及其诚实对应角色，扩展了一个已发表的人格方向库。在每个模型的中间层，所得的人格方向在Liars' Bench基准上对四个模型中的三个进行谎言排序时，表现优于单数据集探针；但在Qwen上则失败，即便Qwen保持角色扮演的频率远高于其他模型。在Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct上，它优于来自随机人格方向库的方向，但相对于已发表方向的提升处于随机扩展的波动范围之内。在关于知识的谎言上，人格方向主要追踪回复的措辞：在谎言与诚实否认用词相同的场景中，我们的三种主要对比方法在Llama和Qwen上仍处于随机方向的波动范围内。
tldr: 该研究通过向人格方向库中加入“否认已知知识”的角色构建无标签谎言检测方向，发现其在70B规模模型的大多数谎言类型上优于单数据集探针，但在谎言与诚实否认措辞相同的知识类谎言上失效，揭示出人格方向主要依赖表面措辞而非深层欺骗意图。
en_tdlr: This study extends label-free persona directions for LLM lie detection with knowledge-denial roles, showing they outperform single-dataset probes across most 70B-scale models, but fail on lies about knowledge where lies and honest denials share wording, revealing that persona directions mainly track surface wording rather than deep deceptive intent.
